==Decode==

SELECT program, 
       SUM(DECODE(g.course_ID, 'COSC111', 1, 0)) COSC111,
       SUM(DECODE(g.course_ID, 'COSC121', 1, 0)) COSC121,
       SUM(DECODE(g.course_ID, 'COSC222', 1, 0)) COSC222,
FROM students s, grades g
WHERE s.student_ID = g.student_ID
GROUP BY program
ORDER BY program;

== Superkey ==
A superkey is any combination of columns that determines all the other columns

All columns together is a trivial superkey

A minimal superkey (also known as a candidate key) is a superkey of which removing any column will make it no longer a superkey. There can be multiple minimal superkeys, it is not the smallest superkey
